itens.documentos: Here you will create documents from templates, review the preview, generate the PDF and follow the version history of each one.
itens.modelos: Here you will find the office templates, with typed variables, published versions and approval before use.
itens.assinaturas: Here you will follow documents sent for signature, who has signed and what is pending.
itens.clientes: Here you will keep the office clients, with only the data you need and quick search.
itens.equipe: Here you will invite people to the office and decide what each one can see and do.
itens.relatorios: Here you will see the office numbers: documents produced, time to signature and pending items.
itens.integracoes: Here you will connect Meuproduto to other services, such as e-signature providers.
itens.configuracoes: Here you will find the office settings: organization details, security policies and preferences.
